limitations: No financial DB, journal, wallet, network or production file was opened. Summaries use existing read-only market/result interfaces without a completed financial backup.
Six closed ten-second buckets remain required. Window counts are distinct endpoints, not independent minutes; union-covered time is reported separately by token.
Candidate allocation within baseline entry age is not financial-entry-enabled time or predictive qualification. Financial execution remains unauthorized for both frozen runs.
Independent audit scopes are the existing bounded confirmed pool-history scopes, not full-market/finality/receive-time completeness proof. Later audit availability is not backdated.
Age bins classify observed opportunities and cannot prove an optimum age window, missed executable profits or causal performance improvement across different markets.
No fill, fee, $50 execution estimate, P&L or price-based outcome is fabricated from these flow-only observations.
Independent indexed leads require real on-chain origin/support joins. Absent proof remains unavailable; no recall percentage is calculated.
